helpFlip: f / flip             turn up your next face-down card
helpBid: bid <amount>         raise the offer and buy
helpSell: a / accept           accept the offer (sell or buy)
offerToYou: {{buyer}} offers {{amount}} for your card. `a` to sell, `d` to decline.
offerFromYou: {{owner}} will part with the best trump for {{amount}}. `a` to buy, `bid <amount>` to raise, `d` to pass.
voidRound: No trump appeared. The stakes are returned.
hintFlip: Turn one up and see — there is still room to be outdone
hintSell: Sell: plenty of cards are still face down, so this lead will likely be beaten
hintHold: Hold: few cards remain, so this one may well take the pot
hintBuy: Buy: few cards remain, so this one may well take the pot
hintPass: Pass: plenty of cards are still face down, so a purchase could be beaten
